_why: The premade build already carries most of the Blood redesign -- Rune Tap,
Improved Rune Tap, Mark of Blood, Will of the Necropolis and Subversion --
so this is a two-talent change rather than a rebuild:
Bloody Lesions 3/3          (T3.3) Blood Boil applies a bleed and
refreshes the diseases already on the target.
This is what lets one global do the work of
Pestilence plus a strike, and the solo
rotation is written around it. Without it
Blood Boil is a rune spent on nothing.
Improved Blood Presence 2/2 (T6.2) presence swaps become free, Blood
Presence grants extra damage, and the healing
bonus is retained in the other presences. A
solo death knight swaps presence to survive a
pull and swaps back; a raid one never does.
Funded by the 5-point Frost dip, which is Toughness 5/5 and nothing else.
Armour is the one thing this build is not short of -- Blade Barrier 5/5,
Veteran of the Third War 3/3 and Blood Gorged 5/5 are all already bought --
and the two talents above are the difference between the redesign running
and not running.
61 Blood / 10 Unholy.
